summary: Tested M2-S05 (ui, built by metadata-builder): two Opportunity PathAssistants (Enterprise_Opportunity_Path, Renewal_Opportunity_Path) plus the org PathAssistant.settings-meta.xml. Ran all three declared checkers verbatim from the build directory exactly as the plan wrote them: check_path_and_guidance.py at the plan's declared build scope (--manifest-dir artefacts), which printed 'Checked 2 path(s): no issues found.' and exited 0, matching the plan's own fixture description -- it resolved both recordTypeName values against M1-S01's record types and matched all six picklistValueName values against the business processes and the OpportunityStage value set; check_opportunity_management.py at step scope (--manifest-dir artefacts/M2-S05), which exited 0 with 'No issues found.' on path-internal shape; and check_sales_process_mapping.py at step scope (--manifest-dir artefacts/M2-S05), which exited 0 but printed 'Scanned 0 file(s) -- nothing asserted; check --manifest-dir' -- recorded honestly as an exit-0 pass on the declared 'expected: exit 0' condition and NOT as a pass on the paths' content, per this step's own deploy-order.md section 7, which already names this as a plan defect (the checker's assertions -- *.yaml/*.yml/*.csv sales-process maps and a retrieved OpportunityStage value set -- are not satisfiable inside this step's artefacts, which are PathAssistant/Settings XML only). Also ran the always-on xml parse (4/4 files: package.xml, settings/PathAssistant.settings-meta.xml, both pathAssistant files), the always-on manifest consistency check (PathAssistant members Enterprise_Opportunity_Path and Renewal_Opportunity_Path, and Settings member PathAssistant using the type-name-without-Settings-suffix form, each with a file behind it, both directions consistent, no wildcard, no coverage-gap exclusion needed), and check-outputs --hashes (ok, nothing missing/empty/malformed, hashes captured into results.json). All five runnable tests passed. The step's two manual acceptance tests were checked against the Given/When/Then shape (both have all three clauses and a directly-inspectable Then) and deferred verbatim to the M2 milestone gate rather than ticked; as a courtesy this run also read the shipped XML and deploy-order.md against both Then clauses without ticking them, and both hold exactly as written. results.json written with "passed": true and artefact_hashes from check-outputs --hashes; M2-S05 moved built -> tested via build_plan.py set-status (exit 0; 19 pre-existing WARNs printed by the full-plan validate pass, none naming M2-S05 or its cited skills).
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran (or was correctly classified as manual), both always-on checks completed, and every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly -- the Step 7 HIGH row in agents/step-tester/AGENT.md. No command test was refused, no manifest exclusion had to be applied, and check-outputs reported ok with nothing missing, empty or malformed. check_sales_process_mapping.py's 'nothing asserted' result does not itself trigger the MEDIUM row (that row is keyed to a refused command test, a coverage-gap manifest exclusion, or a check-outputs problem, none of which occurred here) -- it is reported as a Process Observation instead of a confidence downgrade, per this run's instruction to record it honestly as exit 0 with nothing asserted rather than as a pass on the paths.

process_observations.observation: check_path_and_guidance.py exited 0 at the plan's declared build scope and actually resolved both recordTypeName values (Enterprise, Renewal) against M1-S01's RecordType metadata and all six picklistValueName values against the two BusinessProcess definitions and the OpportunityStage standard value set -- a checker that proved a real cross-reference, not merely a green exit. Its own fixture description in plan.json predicted this exact output ('Checked 2 path(s): no issues found.') and the live run matched it verbatim.

check_sales_process_mapping.py's declared test on this step exits 0 but its own stdout says it scanned 0 files and asserted nothing -- the checker was added to this step by amend-step --add-checker on 2026-09-18 to close a section-5 coverage warning (the step cites admin/sales-process-mapping in skills[]), but this step's artefacts are PathAssistant/Settings XML, not the *.yaml/*.yml/*.csv sales-process maps or retrieved OpportunityStage value set that checker inspects. The step's own deploy-order.md section 7 already documents this as a plan defect and proposes three remedies (re-declare at build scope over artefacts, move it to an M2 milestone acceptance test, or drop the citation to reflect that the skill is used only for its Questions-to-Ask table). None of the three remedies is this tester's to apply. The exit 0 satisfies the declared 'expected: exit 0' and is recorded as a pass, but a reader of a green test list should not infer any sales-process-mapping content was validated here.

deploy-order.md section 3 records that Renewal_Opportunity_Path renders only if Northwind's existing (pre-build) Opportunity Lightning record page already carries the runtime_sales_pathassistant:pathAssistant component -- M3-S05 (pending) only rebuilds the Enterprise page. Nothing in this build asserts whether the current Renewal-facing page already carries that component; the deploy-order note gives a human an sf project retrieve + grep command to check it before the M2 gate. This is a real open question the artefacts themselves surface, not a defect in this step's outputs.
